headline: Approved plan and recommendations from Ad Hoc Joint Committee on Capital Expenditures and Debt Service Planning.
summary: Administrative Services Director Tim Cummings and CFO Dawn Enwright presented an updated plan from the Ad Hoc Joint Committee on Capital Expenditures and Debt Service Planning. The Board voted to accept and approve the plan and its recommendations.
decisions: Approved the plan and recommendations presented by the Ad Hoc Joint Committee on Capital Expenditures and Debt Service Planning; Alderwoman Kelly abstained and Alderman Johnson was opposed.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION BY ALDERMAN KLEE TO ACCEPT AND APPROVE THE PLAN AND RECOMMENDATIONS AS PRESENTED BY THE AD HOC JOINT COMMITTEE ON CAPITAL EXPENDITURES AND DEBT SERVICE PLANNING MOTION CARRIED (Alderwoman Kelly abstained; Alderman Johnson in opposition)

plain_text:
A Special Meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 7:01 pm in the Aldermanic 
Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91 -
A:2 II. 
   
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Daniel Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Daniel Healey; Alderwoman Vengerflutta Smith led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 14 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons (arrived at 7:19), 
Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Dowd, 
Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, 
Alderman Wilshire.    
 
Alderman Gregg was recorded absent. 
 
Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton was also in attendance. 
 
COMMUNICATIONS 
 
From: President Lori Wilshire, Board of Aldermen 
Re: Calling a Special Board of Aldermen meeting on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 7:00 PM  
 
There being no objection, President Wilshire accepted the communication and placed it on file.  
 
DISCUSSIONS AND/OR PRESENTATIONS 
• Updated Plan presentation by Ad Hoc Joint Committee on Capital Expenditures and Debt Service Planning  
President Wilshire recognized Administrative Services Director Tim Cummings and CFO Dawn Enwright. 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN KLEE TO ACCEPT AND APPROVE THE PLAN AND RECOMMENDATIONS AS 
PRESENTED BY THE AD HOC JOINT COMMITTEE ON CAPITAL EXPENDITURES AND DEBT SERVICE 
PLANNING 
MOTION CARRIED (Alderwoman Kelly abstained; Alderman Johnson in opposition)  
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN CLEMONS THAT THE AUGUST 11, 2026 SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF 
ALDERMEN BE ADJOURNED 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 7:24 p.m.             
 
                Attest:  Daniel Healey, City Clerk
